name: Locke
notes: Opens with Purgatory (R) at t=0: the totem travels 0.5s then, after a 0.25s landing delay, fires its magic nail damage; if the target is at or below the execute threshold right after that hit, a true-damage execute is dealt in the same resolution (the dossier leaves this timing open; instant resolution is the simplest and most common reading).

Soul Ignition (W) is cast as soon as it is off cooldown (t=0) purely for its attack-speed buff; its grey-health banking and heal-on-recast do not matter to a damage race against a stationary dummy and are not modeled, nor is its health-per-tick cost (mana/health resources are not modeled per the general rule, since neither plausibly stops a cast inside 15s at this rank).

Ritual Nails (Q) is cast on cooldown and both free recasts are always taken back-to-back at their fixed 0.5s intervals (unaffected by haste) to land all three nails and reach 3 Soul Nails stacks as fast as possible; the ability's cooldown starts when the last recast lands (post-effect), matching its 'cdstart = post-effect' data.

Every basic attack applies Silver Stake's (P) bonus magic on-hit, scaled continuously from +10% AP (0% target missing health) up to +20% AP (70%+ missing health, capping there per the wiki's stated formula), and also consumes any live Soul Nails stacks for their bonus damage if present.

Ashen Pursuit (E) is cast on cooldown: its blink damage lands on cast, and 0.1s later its empowered dash lands separately, dealing its own damage and applying the same on-hit effects (Silver Stake plus Soul Nails consumption) to the target; the dash does not touch the attack timer, matching the wiki's note that it is not a basic attack.
Locke's permanent Sealed Champion stacks (from prior kills, raising R's execute threshold) are assumed to be 0 for a level-16 damage fight with no prior takedowns.
W's cooldown array uses the ddragon/wiki-agreeing values [18,17,16,15,14] rather than the bin's disagreeing [20,18,16,14,12].
R's cast time uses the bin's 0.25s cast lock; the wiki's separate 0.5s is modeled as the totem's travel time before its 0.25s landing delay, so total time from cast to nail damage is 0.75s.
